services.name: Nature & Lobstering Tour
services.desc: Learn about Maine's fishing industry and wildlife, haul a few lobster traps, and take in the incomparable beauty of the Maine coast! Duration 2 hours About Enjoy nature at its best! Cruise past Bass Harbor Head Lighthouse and experience the outer islands of Blue Hill Bay up close and personal– from ledges where seals sun and swim, to small islands with nesting birds and ducks. When the porpoise are running or the eagles are hunting, we’ll be sure to stop to give our passengers a real treat! Due to Coast Guard regulation our passenger count must include all souls on board, tickets are required. Seating is general admission. Available Times Monday-Saturday -Contact Information: We will only

services.name: Sailboat Charter
services.desc: Enjoy one of the finest sailing destinations, and views and wildlife of Acadia National Park aboard our beautiful 36’ sailboat, Motu Iti (“Little Island” in Rapa Nui)! Dates and times Dates: beginning mid June through September Tour Times daily About When you charter Motu Iti, the boat and our experienced, knowledgeable charter Captain are yours for the duration. Sailing is a great way to experience the coast of Maine. Whether it’s sightseeing and wildlife, or learning to sail for the first time, we make sure you have the best trip possible, tailored to your interests. Boat holds 6 people

services.name: Sightseeing Charter
services.desc: Your Captain knows and loves the area, and will work with you to create the best ride Dates and times Dates: June through early October Tour Times: 8:00am - sunset, departing on the hour About Whether you’re looking for premium, private sightseeing on Blue Hill Bay, wildlife like seals, bald eagles and porpoise, or you want to hit the blue water in search of whales or puffins we’ve got the perfect trip. Island visits like having Acadia National Park all to yourself! Visit sand beaches, granite cliffs, popplestone beaches, meadows and enjoy miles of hiking trails, or a picnic. Or pull up to a dockside restaurant for lunch. Boat holds 6 people maximum -Contact Information: We will only use
